{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm that biomarker_baseline has sentinel value -999.0
print(f"Sentinel value -999.0 in biomarker_baseline: {trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999.0).sum()}")

# Check if the sentinel value is used consistently
print(f"Rows with sentinel value in biomarker_baseline: {trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0].shape[0]}")

# Check if those rows are missing in biomarker_final
print(f"Rows with sentinel value in biomarker_baseline and non-null biomarker_final: {trial_df[(trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0) & (trial_df['biomarker_final'].notnull())].shape[0]}")

# Check the response rate for patients with sentinel baseline
sentinel_mask = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0
print(f"Response rate for patients with sentinel baseline: {trial_df[sentinel_mask]['responded'].mean():.3f}")

# Check the response rate for patients without sentinel baseline
non_sentinel_mask = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0
print(f"Response rate for patients without sentinel baseline: {trial_df[non_sentinel_mask]['responded'].mean():.3f}")"}
